title: TimelineRecord
description:
One attempt in a video's append-only execution history.

A sequence attempt names its `sequence`; the record that closes a run has none and
carries the terminal message. `outcome` is `completed`, `cancelled`, or `failed`.

fps.description: Frames processed per second of wall-clock duration.

message.description: The engine's terminal message, including a failure reason.

run_id.description: The run this attempt belongs to.

sequence.description: The sequence that ran, or `None` for the run's terminal record.
